pr.title: Fix misleading AppHost build failure diagnostics
pr.author: ellahathaway

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Hosting.Azure / Hosting.Azure (ubuntu-latest)
failed_jobs.reason: The job failed due to a 'Collection was modified; enumeration operation may not execute' race condition inside the pipeline step execution engine (DistributedApplicationPipeline), unrelated to the PR's changes which only touch Aspire.Cli.Projects.ProjectLocator and CLI tests. This matches a known class of thread-safety flakes previously seen (see prior cause servicebus-azureeventsource-collection-modified) involving concurrent list enumeration during pipeline steps.
